Name: Stardust Core
Author: Omegasis
Description:
This mod is a core component of some of my other mods that are a bit more complex in nature. It is required in order to run the following mods:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/425/?tab=description]Stardew Symphony Remastered[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url]﻿

[/list]
[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 3.0 or later.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
Helps dependent mods that I made run.


[size=5]Compatibility Notes:
[/size]Note that stardust core says that it accesses the game's save serializer. You can ignore this part as it doesn't change how saving works.

[size=5]See also[/size][list]
[*][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/happybirthday.122685/]Official discussion thread[/url]

[*]
[/list]
